announcements.headline: Medivir: Regulatory tailwind from the FDA in OI
announcements.insight: FDA Rare Pediatric Disease Designation for MIV-711 follows recent US combination patent grants. This regulatory tailwind supports Medivir’s development pathway for fostrox plus lenvatinib.

announcements.headline: FDA grants Medivir’s MIV-711 Rare Pediatric Disease Designation for Osteogenesis Imperfecta
announcements.insight: FDA grants MIV-711 Rare Pediatric Disease Designation for Osteogenesis Imperfecta. This follows recent US combination patent extensions and Q3 liver cancer updates.

announcements.headline: Medivir granted US combination patent for fostrox plus lenvatinib, protection extended by almost three years to January 2044
announcements.insight: Patent protection for fostrox plus lenvatinib extends to January 2044. This follows Q3 review positioning as a liver cancer challenger.

announcements.headline: Medivir (Q3 Review): A New Challenger in Second-Line Liver Cancer
announcements.insight: This follows the September interim report. Shareholders should watch for further clinical or commercial updates.

announcements.headline: MEDIVIR AB – INTERIM REPORT JANUARY – SEPTEMBER 2026
announcements.insight: Medivir AB released its interim report for January to September 2026, following the June period results. This provides a standard update on the company's performance for the first nine months of the year.

announcements.headline: Number of shares and votes in Medivir AB on September 30, 2026
announcements.insight: Medivir AB reports its share count as of September 30, 2026. This follows a directed share issue in July and an EGM in July.

announcements.headline: MEDIVIR AB – INTERIM REPORT JANUARY – JUNE 2026
announcements.insight: Interim results follow a recent capital raise. Shareholders should monitor how the new funds are deployed to drive future performance.

announcements.headline: Number of shares and votes in Medivir AB after Directed Share Issue
announcements.insight: Following the directed share issue in June, this filing updates the post-issuance capital structure. Shareholders should monitor the July Extraordinary General Meeting outcomes for further governance changes.

announcements.headline: Bulletin from the Extraordinary General Meeting in Medivir AB (publ)
announcements.insight: The bulletin confirms the outcome of the Extraordinary General Meeting following the June directed share issue. Shareholders should note the formal ratification of the capital raise.

announcements.headline: Number of shares and votes in Medivir AB on 30 June 2026
announcements.insight: The share count update follows the June directed issue and admission disclosure. Shareholders should monitor subsequent filings for further capital activity details.

announcements.headline: Medivir Publishes disclosure document for the admission to trading of shares on Nasdaq Stockholm
announcements.insight: Shares are admitted to Nasdaq Stockholm following the June directed share issue. This listing marks a significant step for investors in the capital raise.

announcements.headline: Notice of Extraordinary General Meeting of Medivir AB (publ)
Medivir has completed a directed share issue of approximately SEK 140 million
announcements.insight: Medivir AB completed a directed share issue of approximately SEK 140 million. This capital raise may dilute existing shareholders.
